mondai1.trans: 在外吃饭容易蔬菜不足。
mondai1.trans_en: Eating out tends to leave you short on vegetables.
mondai1.point: 「〜がち」表示容易陷入某种不良倾向。
mondai1.point_en: がち marks an undesirable tendency.

mondai1.trans: 虽然在读，内容却一点也进不了脑子。
mondai1.trans_en: I am reading, but none of it is sinking in.
mondai1.point: 「ものの」表示逆接，多用于书面。
mondai1.point_en: ものの is a written-style contrast.

mondai1.trans: 最近有点发胖，所以决定走到车站，不坐公交。
mondai1.trans_en: I've been putting on a bit of weight, so I decided to walk to the station.
mondai1.point: 「気味」表示略微偏向某种状态。
mondai1.point_en: 気味 means slightly / a touch of.

mondai1.trans: 一向自信满满的他，今天却一脸没自信。
mondai1.trans_en: He is usually full of confidence, but today he looks unsure.
mondai1.point_en: 自信なさげ is the set form.

mondai1.trans: 看着生病的孩子，真希望能替他生病。
mondai1.trans_en: Watching a sick child, I wish I could take their place if I could.
mondai1.point: 可能形＋ものなら表示难以实现的愿望。
mondai1.point_en: Potential + ものなら is a hard-to-realize wish.

mondai1.trans: 总觉得部长最近爱发脾气了。
mondai1.trans_en: I feel the manager has gotten rather short-tempered lately.
mondai1.point_en: っぽい attaches to the masu stem.

mondai1.trans: 因为太安静了，我还以为没人在。
mondai1.trans_en: It was so quiet I thought nobody was there.
mondai1.point: な形容词后接「な＋ものだから」。
mondai1.point_en: na-adjectives take な before ものだから.

mondai1.trans: 忘把伞带来也就罢了，连重要的包都忘了。
mondai1.trans_en: Forgetting an umbrella is one thing, but leaving your important bag behind?
mondai1.point: 「まだしも」表示相比之下前者还勉强可以接受。
mondai1.point_en: まだしも: the first thing is still tolerable.

mondai1.trans: 村上这个名字在国内自不必说，在国外也广为人知。
mondai1.trans_en: Murakami's name is known overseas, let alone at home.
mondai1.point: 「もとより」表示前者当然成立，后者也成立。
mondai1.point_en: もとより = not to mention the first item.

mondai1.trans: 修一修也不是不能用，但太旧了，还是扔了吧。
mondai1.trans_en: It's not that it couldn't be used if repaired, but it's old, so let's throw it out.
mondai1.point: 「ないこともない」表示并非完全不可能。
mondai1.point_en: ないこともない = it's not impossible.

mondai1.trans: 最近身体不好，但不能老请假。
mondai1.trans_en: I've been unwell, but I can't keep taking time off.
mondai1.point: 「〜てばかりもいられない」表示不能只顾着那样。
mondai1.point_en: てばかりもいられない = can't keep doing only that.

mondai1.trans: “为什么不带手机？”“因为用不着嘛。”
mondai1.trans_en: “Why don't you have a cell phone?” “Because I don't need one.”
option_translations_en: not that I don't need it
mondai1.point: 「んだもの」用来申明理由，口语。
mondai1.point_en: んだもの gives a casual reason.

mondai1.trans: 十多年没去电影院了。也不是不想去，只是在家看录像更轻松。
mondai1.trans_en: I haven't been to a cinema in over ten years. It's not that I don't want to; watching at home is easier.
option_translations_en: it's not that I don't want to
mondai1.point: 「行きたくないこともない」＝也不是不想去。
mondai1.point_en: 行きたくないこともない = it's not that I don't want to.

mondai1.trans: 今晚得熬夜干活，可喝了浓茶咖啡还是困得受不了。
mondai1.trans_en: I have to work through the night, yet I'm unbearably sleepy even after strong tea and coffee.
option_translations_en: so sleepy I can't stand it
it's not that I don't sleep
mondai1.point: 「〜てたまらない」表示程度高到受不了。
mondai1.point_en: てたまらない = so … I can't stand it.

mondai1.trans: 这游戏规矩很多，但今天是第一次，先不谈难的，总之先试试吧。
mondai1.trans_en: The game has lots of little rules, but since it's your first time, never mind the hard part — let's just try.
mondai1.point: 「抜きにして」表示先抛开某事。
mondai1.point_en: 抜きにして = setting that aside.

mondai2.trans: 身体好不好另说，总不能说精神不好。
mondai2.trans_en: Leaving how I feel aside, I can hardly say my body is fine.
mondai2.point_en: Aはともかく B = never mind A, as for B.

mondai2.trans: 她用一副可爱得没办法的表情盯着孙子。
mondai2.trans_en: She gazes at her grandchild with a face that says she can't help finding them adorable.
mondai2.point: 「かわいくてしかたないという顔」。
mondai2.point_en: てしかたない = so … one can't help it.

mondai2.trans: 想买的话也不是买不到，只是不想买。
mondai2.trans_en: It's not that I couldn't buy it if I wanted to; I just don't feel like it.
mondai2.point_en: ないこともない = not entirely impossible.

mondai2.trans: 没有他的活跃，我们队根本不可能夺冠。
mondai2.trans_en: Without his contribution our team could never have won.
mondai2.point_en: ぬきにしては = if you leave that out.

mondai2.trans: 对那些不抽烟就受不了的人，也不能不提醒香烟的危害。
mondai2.trans_en: You can't help warning people who can't go without smoking about the dangers.
mondai2.point: 「ずにはいられない」表示忍不住做。
mondai2.point_en: ずにはいられない = can't help doing.

mondai3.trans: 可是我与其说在享受，不如说更担心选手的心情和身体。
mondai3.trans_en: But rather than enjoying it, I can't help worrying about the athletes.
mondai3.point_en: しかし marks contrast with the previous enjoyment.

mondai3.trans: 担心得不得了。
mondai3.trans_en: I can't help being worried.
option_translations_en: so worried I can't help it
mondai3.point: 「心配でならない」表示感情强烈。
mondai3.point_en: でならない = so … I can't help it.

mondai3.trans: 也有人看上去有些疲倦。
mondai3.trans_en: Some people look a little worn out.
mondai3.point_en: 気味 = slightly.

mondai3.trans: 年轻新选手尚且如此，被期待夺牌的选手就更不用说了。
mondai3.trans_en: If that's true even of young newcomers, how much more for medal favorites.
mondai3.point: 「まだしも」：前者相对还能接受。
mondai3.point_en: まだしも: the first case is still easier to accept.

mondai3.trans: 我忍不住这样想。
mondai3.trans_en: I can't help thinking that way.
mondai3.point_en: ずにはいられない = can't help doing.

mondai1.trans: 围巾织到一半就停下了。
mondai1.trans_en: I started knitting a muffler but gave up halfway.
mondai1.point_en: Vかけ = start but not finish.

mondai1.trans: 那项运动原本是作为护身而想出来的。
mondai1.trans_en: The sport was originally devised for self-defense.
mondai1.point_en: として = as / in the role of.

mondai1.trans: 请趁汤还没凉赶紧用。
mondai1.trans_en: Please eat the soup while it is still hot.
mondai1.point: 「Vないうちに」表示趁还没发生。
mondai1.point_en: Vないうちに = while it still hasn't happened.

mondai1.trans: 他烦恼到极点，最终还是说出了真相。
mondai1.trans_en: After worrying himself sick, he finally told the truth.
mondai1.point_en: Vぬく = do it all the way / thoroughly.

mondai1.trans: 只要学生没有干劲，老师再努力也进步不了。
mondai1.trans_en: As long as the students aren't motivated, no amount of teaching will help.
mondai1.point_en: Vないかぎり = so long as … not.

mondai1.trans: 偏偏没复习的地方会考到。
mondai1.trans_en: Of all things, the parts I didn't study come up on the test.
mondai1.point: 「にかぎって」表示偏偏是这种情况。
mondai1.point_en: にかぎって = of all times / only then.

mondai1.trans: 旧的还没用完，先用完再开新的吧。
mondai1.trans_en: There's still some of the old one left, so let's finish it before opening a new one.
mondai1.point_en: Vきる = do completely / use up.

mondai1.trans: 天刚亮他们就开始干活。
mondai1.trans_en: They start work at the very moment day breaks.
mondai1.point: 「VるかVないかのうちに」表示几乎同时。
mondai1.point_en: VるかVないかのうちに = hardly has A happened when B.

mondai1.trans: 仅限小学生及以下儿童赠送礼物。
mondai1.trans_en: A present is given only to children in elementary school or younger.
mondai1.point_en: にかぎり = limited to.

mondai1.trans: 正是因为考虑你的健康，才不让你喝酒。
mondai1.trans_en: It's precisely because I care about your health that I won't let you drink.
mondai1.point_en: からこそ stresses the reason.

mondai1.trans: 只要身体好，生活总能过下去。
mondai1.trans_en: As long as I'm healthy I can get by somehow.
mondai1.point_en: さえ〜ば = if only that condition is met.

mondai1.trans: 免费体验课仅限一次。
mondai1.trans_en: The free trial lesson is limited to one session.
mondai1.point_en: かぎり after a number = only that many.

mondai1.trans: 那么好的人居然做坏事，不可能。
mondai1.trans_en: There's no way such a good person would do something bad.
mondai1.point_en: ありえない = cannot be.

mondai1.trans: 请按照这份一周菜单做菜。
mondai1.trans_en: Please cook according to this week's menu.
mondai1.point: 「Nにしたがって」表示按照指示。
mondai1.point_en: にしたがって = following / according to.

mondai1.trans: 明天首相访问本市，随之这条路预计会堵。
mondai1.trans_en: The prime minister visits tomorrow, so this road is expected to be congested.
mondai1.point: 「それにともなって」表示随之发生。
mondai1.point_en: にともなって = accompanying that change.

mondai2.trans: 汉字、听解、读解都还行，语法只要肯做应该就没问题。
mondai2.trans_en: Kanji, listening and reading are OK, so grammar should be fine if you just do it.
mondai2.point_en: さえ〜ば = if only.

mondai2.trans: 对只能在休息日旅行的人来说，这套收费很残酷。
mondai2.trans_en: For people who can only travel on holidays, this pricing is harsh.
mondai2.point_en: にしたら = from that person's standpoint.

mondai2.trans: 派对准备都好了，就只等客人了。
mondai2.trans_en: Party prep is done; all that's left is to wait for the guests.
mondai2.point_en: Vるばかり = nothing left but to.

mondai2.trans: 这几年随着景气恶化，就业率大幅下降。
mondai2.trans_en: Employment has fallen sharply along with the worsening economy in recent years.
mondai2.point_en: にともない = along with (formal).

mondai2.trans: 随着手机普及，公用电话不再被使用。
mondai2.trans_en: As cell phones spread, public phones stopped being used.
mondai2.point: 「につれて」表示一边变化一边发生。
mondai2.point_en: につれて = as X changes, Y happens.

mondai3.trans: 尽管各国努力，情况却毫无改善。
mondai3.trans_en: Despite various countries' efforts, the situation hasn't improved at all.
mondai3.point_en: かいもなく = without the effort paying off.

mondai3.trans: 状况一个劲儿地恶化。
mondai3.trans_en: The situation just keeps getting worse.
mondai3.point: 「するばかりだ」＝一个劲儿地变糟。
mondai3.point_en: ばかりだ = keep doing / only getting worse.

mondai3.trans: 据说南极冰全部融化也是有可能的。
mondai3.trans_en: They say it is possible all the Antarctic ice will melt.
mondai3.point_en: ありうる = can happen.

mondai3.trans: 甚至用混凝土保护海岸来阻止海面上升。
mondai3.trans_en: Some places even protect the coast with concrete to hold it back.
option_translations_en: go so far as to protect
mondai3.point: 「てまで」表示甚至做到那种程度。
mondai3.point_en: てまで = going so far as to.

mondai3.trans: 只要我们活着，就必须保护环境。
mondai3.trans_en: For as long as we live we must protect the environment.
mondai3.point_en: Vている限り = so long as that state continues.

mondai1.trans: 那人来上课只有一次。
mondai1.trans_en: That person came to class only once.
mondai1.point_en: きり = only that and nothing more.

mondai1.trans: 因为太高兴，忍不住叫了出来。
mondai1.trans_en: I was so happy I couldn't help crying out.
mondai1.point_en: Nのあまり = so much that.

mondai1.trans: 遗憾的是，养的兔子死了。
mondai1.trans_en: To my regret, the rabbit I was keeping died.
mondai1.point_en: なことに follows na-adjectives.

mondai1.trans: 搬了很多次家，家具已经伤痕累累。
mondai1.trans_en: We've moved so often the furniture is covered in scratches.
mondai1.point_en: だらけ = covered with (negative).

mondai1.trans: 虽然按医生说的做，病却总不好。
mondai1.trans_en: I'm doing as the doctor told me, but the illness just won't go away.
mondai1.point: 「言われたとおり」＝按照被告知的。
mondai1.point_en: Vられたとおり = as one was told.

mondai1.trans: 他让我们干等一个小时，到头来又说今天的商量要取消。
mondai1.trans_en: After making us wait an hour, he ended up saying today's meeting was off.
mondai1.point: 「あげく」表示折腾之后的结果。
mondai1.point_en: あげく = after all that (usually bad).

mondai1.trans: 停业是考虑再三之后的结论。
mondai1.trans_en: Closing the shop is the conclusion we reached after much thought.
mondai1.point_en: Vた末 = after doing that to the end.

mondai1.trans: 她吓得连动都不能动。
mondai1.trans_en: She was so terrified she couldn't even move.
mondai1.point_en: Nのあまり = so much that.

mondai1.trans: 非常抱歉，把借来的书弄脏了。
mondai1.trans_en: I'm terribly sorry — I soiled the book I borrowed.
mondai1.point_en: ことに comments on the whole situation.

mondai1.trans: 身子发飘，量了体温一看，居然39度。
mondai1.trans_en: I felt unsteady, and when I took my temperature it was 39°.
mondai1.point: 「Vたところ」表示做了之后的发现。
mondai1.point_en: Vたところ = when I did, I found.

mondai1.trans: 书借给谁以后就一直没还回来。
mondai1.trans_en: I lent the book to someone and haven't gotten it back since.
mondai1.point_en: Vたきり = since then, nothing more.

mondai1.trans: 与居民意愿相反，公寓还是建起来了。
mondai1.trans_en: The condominium was built against the residents' wishes.
mondai1.point_en: に反して = contrary to.

mondai1.trans: 这几年城市开发，这一带的树林一个劲儿地减少。
mondai1.trans_en: Urban development in recent years has only made the woods around here disappear.
mondai1.point: 「なくなる一方だ」＝一个劲儿地消失。
mondai1.point_en: 一方だ = keep going in that direction.

mondai1.trans: 这么贵重的东西我不能收。
mondai1.trans_en: I really can't accept such an expensive gift.
mondai1.point: 「わけにはいきません」＝情理上不能。
mondai1.point_en: わけにはいかない = can't very well do that.

mondai1.trans: 因故暂时请假，但并不是要辞职。
mondai1.trans_en: I'll take some time off, but that doesn't mean I'm quitting.
mondai1.point: 「わけではありません」否定那种理解。
mondai1.point_en: わけではない = it doesn't mean that.

mondai2.trans: 我家孩子刚从学校回来，转眼又去玩了。
mondai2.trans_en: My kid had no sooner come home from school than they ran off to play.
mondai2.point: 「Vたかと思ったら」表示紧接着发生。
mondai2.point_en: Vたかと思ったら = no sooner had A than B.

mondai2.trans: 那边是早上9点？这边是傍晚4点，所以时差是7小时吧。
mondai2.trans_en: It's 9 a.m. there and 4 p.m. here, so that means a seven-hour time difference.
mondai2.point_en: わけだ = that figures / so that means.

mondai2.trans: 明明是夏天，别说热了，冷得还穿着毛衣。
mondai2.trans_en: It's summer, but far from being hot I'm wearing a sweater because it's cold.
mondai2.point: 「どころか」表示岂止如此，情况相反。
mondai2.point_en: どころか = far from it / on the contrary.

mondai2.trans: 今早地震弄得盘子都碎了，哪里还顾得上吃饭。
mondai2.trans_en: The earthquake smashed dishes this morning — I was in no state to eat.
mondai2.point_en: どころではない = in no condition to.

mondai2.trans: 虽然按人家告诉的路去了，要找的房子却没找到。
mondai2.trans_en: I went the way I was told, but still couldn't find the house.
mondai2.point_en: とおりに = exactly as.

mondai3.trans: 检查了一下，说是没什么异常。
mondai3.trans_en: When I had it checked, they said there was nothing unusual.
mondai3.point_en: Vたところ = when I did, I found.

mondai3.trans: 刚说没异常，反而更担心了。
mondai3.trans_en: The moment they said nothing was wrong I started worrying even more.
mondai3.point_en: Vたとたん = the moment that happened.

mondai3.trans: 这么疼却说哪儿都没病，不可能。
mondai3.trans_en: There's no way nothing is wrong when it hurts this much.
mondai3.point_en: わけがない = there's no reason / no way.

mondai3.trans: 苦恼到最后，决定去大医院的神经科。
mondai3.trans_en: After much anguish I decided to go to the neurology department of a big hospital.
mondai3.point_en: Vた末 = after doing it to the end.

mondai3.trans: 脑子里一直想着去大医院。
mondai3.trans_en: I just kept thinking of heading to a big hospital.
option_translations_en: keep heading there in my mind
mondai3.point: 文脉是心里一直想着去，用「向かいっぱなし」。
mondai3.point_en: っぱなし = left in that state / keep doing.

mondai1.trans: 值此应试之际，请注意以下几点。
mondai1.trans_en: Please note the following points as you sit the exam.
mondai1.point_en: にあたり = on the occasion of.

mondai1.trans: 从B国出口到日本的农产品有八成是水果。
mondai1.trans_en: 80% of farm products exported from country B to Japan are fruit.
mondai1.point_en: 向け = intended for.

mondai1.trans: 一有新消息就通知您。
mondai1.trans_en: We'll let you know as soon as new information comes in.
mondai1.point_en: 次第 after a masu stem = as soon as.

mondai1.trans: 这道菜做法简单，而且材料也便宜。
mondai1.trans_en: This dish is easy to make, and on top of that the ingredients are cheap.
mondai1.point_en: 上に = and what's more.

mondai1.trans: 她对他突然求婚既吃惊，却又显得高兴。
mondai1.trans_en: She was surprised at his sudden proposal, yet she looked happy.
mondai1.point_en: ながらも = even while / and yet.

mondai1.trans: 在会议开始之前，对与会者做了问卷调查。
mondai1.trans_en: A questionnaire was given to participants before the meeting.
mondai1.point_en: に先立ち = prior to.

mondai1.trans: 从数字上看景气在恢复，我们却感觉不到。
mondai1.trans_en: On paper the economy is recovering, but we don't feel it.
mondai1.point_en: Nの上では = on paper / in terms of.

mondai1.trans: 即便情况相同，幸福与否也取决于想法。
mondai1.trans_en: Even in the same situation, happiness depends on how you think.
mondai1.point_en: 次第で = depending on.

mondai1.trans: 这本习题集是按照实际考试形式编写的。
mondai1.trans_en: This workbook is written along the lines of the real exam.
mondai1.point_en: にそって = along / in accordance with.

mondai1.trans: 这是汇总了长达六年观测数据的资料。
mondai1.trans_en: This summarizes observational data spanning six years.
mondai1.point: 「にわたる」修饰名词，表示时间跨度。
mondai1.point_en: にわたる = spanning (prenominal).

mondai1.trans: 看过实物之后再决定买不买。
mondai1.trans_en: I'll decide whether to buy it after I've seen the real thing.
mondai1.point_en: Vた上で = after doing that, then.

mondai1.trans: 一边对孩子说要学习，大人自己却不学，我觉得不好。
mondai1.trans_en: It's wrong for adults to tell children to study while not studying themselves.
mondai1.point_en: つつ = while (written).

mondai1.trans: 按老规矩，女性不得进入这里面。
mondai1.trans_en: By long-standing custom, women are not allowed inside.
mondai1.point: 「ことになっている」表示规定。
mondai1.point_en: ことになっている = it is the rule.

mondai1.trans: 日本美丽的传统正在被日本人遗忘。
mondai1.trans_en: Japan's beautiful traditions are gradually being forgotten by the Japanese.
option_translations_en: have no choice but to forget
are in the process of being forgotten
mondai1.point: 「つつある」表示正在进行的变化。
mondai1.point_en: つつある = be in the process of.

mondai1.trans: 这商品现在确实受欢迎，但不过是一时的流行。
mondai1.trans_en: The product is popular now, but it's only a passing fad.
mondai1.point_en: にすぎない = nothing more than.

mondai2.trans: 我不想撒谎，所以被问到就不得不说真话。
mondai2.trans_en: I don't want to lie, so if I'm asked I have no choice but to tell the truth.
mondai2.point_en: ざるをえない = have no choice but to.

mondai2.trans: 既然已经这样，就再找个别的爱好吧。
mondai2.trans_en: Now that it's come to this, let's look for some other hobby.
mondai2.point_en: Vた上は = now that it has come to this.

mondai2.trans: 总是拖到最后才准备。这次本该更早准备好的。
mondai2.trans_en: I always leave prep to the last minute. I should have started earlier this time too.
mondai2.point_en: ておくべき = should have done it in advance.

mondai2.trans: 因此想请大家给予协助。
mondai2.trans_en: So I would like to ask for everyone's cooperation.
mondai2.point: 「お願いする次第です」郑重说明原委。
mondai2.point_en: 次第です = (formal) that is how it stands / I hereby.

mondai2.trans: 与此相对，四五十岁的人并不支持他。
mondai2.trans_en: By contrast, people in their 40s and 50s don't support him.
mondai2.point_en: に対し = in contrast to that.

mondai3.trans: 值此就业之际，承蒙您多方照顾。
mondai3.trans_en: Thank you for all your help as I started my job.
mondai3.point_en: にあたって = at the time of.

mondai3.trans: 视努力情况，也有可能调到一直希望的营业部。
mondai3.trans_en: Depending on my efforts I may be able to move to sales, which I wanted.
mondai3.point_en: 次第では = depending on.

mondai3.trans: 一边学习前辈的做法，一边一件件记工作。
mondai3.trans_en: I'm learning the job piece by piece while following my seniors.
mondai3.point_en: つつ = while.

mondai3.trans: 夏天也不得不用空调。
mondai3.trans_en: In summer we have no choice but to use the air conditioner.
option_translations_en: have no choice but to use
mondai3.point_en: ざるをえない = cannot avoid doing.

mondai3.trans: 想努力达到前辈的期待。
mondai3.trans_en: I want to work hard to live up to my seniors' expectations.
mondai3.point_en: にこたえる = live up to (expectations).

mondai1.trans: 这座寺因绣球花出名，所以被称为绣球花寺。
mondai1.trans_en: The temple is famous for hydrangeas, which is why it's called Hydrangea Temple.
mondai1.point_en: ことから = on the grounds that.

mondai1.trans: 就因为个子高，我在哪儿都很显眼。
mondai1.trans_en: Just because I'm tall I stand out wherever I am.
mondai1.point: 「ばかりに」表示就因为这个（多带来坏结果）。
mondai1.point_en: ばかりに = just because (unfortunate result).

mondai1.trans: 可以根据预算享受用餐。
mondai1.trans_en: You can enjoy a meal according to your budget.
mondai1.point_en: に応じて = according to / in response to.

mondai1.trans: 不亲自问问本人，就不知道为什么那样做。
mondai1.trans_en: Unless I ask the person themselves I won't know why they did it.
mondai1.point: 「ないことには」＝如果不那样就。
mondai1.point_en: ないことには = unless that happens.

mondai1.trans: 入住本宿舍时，请先读好以下规定。
mondai1.trans_en: When you move into this dorm, please read the following rules first.
mondai1.point_en: に際して = when / at the time of.

mondai1.trans: 正如他自己也承认的，他确实没长性。
mondai1.trans_en: As even he admits, he really does get bored easily.
mondai1.point_en: だけあって = as you'd expect from.

mondai1.trans: 税金是按照这张表计算的。
mondai1.trans_en: Tax is calculated on the basis of this table.
mondai1.point_en: に基づいて = based on.

mondai1.trans: 酒驾不但危害驾驶者，也危害其他人。
mondai1.trans_en: Drunk driving endangers not only the driver but other people too.
mondai1.point_en: ばかりか = not only, but even.

mondai1.trans: 希望孩子能在可信赖的教育者指导下学习。
mondai1.trans_en: I want my child to study under a trustworthy educator.
mondai1.point_en: の下で = under the guidance of.

mondai1.trans: 她的想法和行动普通人很难理解。
mondai1.trans_en: Ordinary people find her thinking and behavior hard to understand.
mondai1.point_en: がたい = hard to (often psychological).

mondai1.trans: 黄花开满田野，简直像铺了黄色地毯。
mondai1.trans_en: Yellow flowers cover the fields, just as if a yellow carpet had been laid.
mondai1.point_en: かのようだ = as if it were.

mondai1.trans: 明天大家一起去给本校足球队加油吧！
mondai1.trans_en: Tomorrow let's all go and cheer on our school's soccer team!
mondai1.point: 「行こうではないか」表示提议。
mondai1.point_en: Vようではないか = let's.

mondai1.trans: 就算许下做不到的诺言，也绝不可能遵守。
mondai1.trans_en: There's no way you can keep a promise you can't actually fulfill.
mondai1.point_en: っこない = no chance of.

mondai1.trans: 会员的个人信息恕难告知。
mondai1.trans_en: I'm afraid we cannot give out members' personal information.
mondai1.point_en: かねる = cannot readily (polite refusal).

mondai1.trans: 那样下去很可能会搞坏身体。
mondai1.trans_en: At that rate she's liable to ruin her health.
mondai1.point: 「かねない」＝很有可能（多指坏事）。
mondai1.point_en: かねない = might well (negative outcome).

mondai2.trans: 那只鸟不但叫声美，姿态也美。
mondai2.trans_en: That bird is beautiful not only in song but in form.
mondai2.point_en: のみか = not only (written).

mondai2.trans: 他很懂意大利，也难怪他一直想去。
mondai2.trans_en: He knows Italy well — no wonder he's been wanting to go.
option_translations_en: enough that he wants to go
mondai2.point_en: だけのことはある = it makes sense / as you'd expect.

mondai2.trans: 以他那么在意时间的脾气，迟到了准会生气。
mondai2.trans_en: Knowing how fussy he is about time, he's sure to be angry if we're late.
option_translations_en: knowing he is the sort who
mondai2.point: 「ことだから」＝就因为他是那种人。
mondai2.point_en: ことだから = knowing what he's like.

mondai2.trans: 无论怎么练都不见进步，但她仍不放弃地继续练。
mondai2.trans_en: Practice brought no progress, but she kept at it without giving up.
mondai2.point_en: ことなく = without doing.

mondai2.trans: 即便没说出口，那种态度也等于在说讨厌。
mondai2.trans_en: Even if it isn't said aloud, that attitude is the same as saying you dislike it.
mondai2.point_en: も同然だ = tantamount to.

mondai3.trans: 就因为英语不好，在海外没法沟通。
mondai3.trans_en: Just because my English is weak I couldn't communicate abroad.
mondai3.point_en: ばかりに = just because (unfortunate).

mondai3.trans: 那样一来旅行的乐趣也很可能会减半。
mondai3.trans_en: Then the fun of the trip might well be cut in half.
mondai3.point_en: かねない = might well.

mondai3.trans: 说一周就能说流利英语，一时难以相信。
mondai3.trans_en: It's hard to believe English would become fluent in just a week.
mondai3.point_en: がたい = hard to.

mondai3.trans: 教材仿佛魔法一般好用。
mondai3.trans_en: The materials work as if by magic.
mondai3.point_en: かのように = as if.

mondai3.trans: 报名参加课程时请确认费用。
mondai3.trans_en: Please check the fee when you sign up for the course.
mondai3.point_en: に際して = when doing.

mondai1.trans: 既然要招待，就打算办成愉快的聚会。
mondai1.trans_en: Since we're inviting people, we intend to make it an enjoyable party.
mondai1.point_en: からには = now that / as long as.

mondai1.trans: 那么失礼的人，我再也不会邀请。
mondai1.trans_en: I'll never invite such a rude person again.
mondai1.point_en: まい = will not (volition / conjecture).

mondai1.trans: 从学校方面来说，家里的问题很难管到。
mondai1.trans_en: From the school's standpoint, they can hardly deal with problems at home.
option_translations_en: from the point of view of
mondai1.point_en: からいえば = speaking from that side.

mondai1.trans: 今日下午两点起在站前广场举行候选人演说。
mondai1.trans_en: From 2 p.m. today there will be a candidate's speech in the plaza in front of the station.
mondai1.point_en: において = at (formal place).

mondai1.trans: 从梅雨到夏天，日本又热又难受。
mondai1.trans_en: From the rainy season through summer, Japan is uncomfortably hot.
mondai1.point: 「から〜にかけて」表示时间跨度。
mondai1.point_en: にかけて = from A through B.

mondai1.trans: 不做准备活动就不能游泳。
mondai1.trans_en: You must not swim until you've done a warm-up.
mondai1.point: 「てからでないと」＝在那之前不行。
mondai1.point_en: てからでないと = not until after.

mondai1.trans: 妹妹理解得慢，但论起认真谁也比不过。
mondai1.trans_en: My sister is slow to understand, but when it comes to effort nobody beats her.
mondai1.point_en: にかけては = when it comes to this point.

mondai1.trans: 既然过集体生活，就必须守规则和礼节。
mondai1.trans_en: If you're going to live together, you have to keep the rules and manners.
mondai1.point_en: 以上 = now that that's the case.

mondai1.trans: 这汤单看颜色就显得很辣。
mondai1.trans_en: This soup looks spicy just from the color.
mondai1.point_en: からして = even judging from that alone.

mondai1.trans: 从外来人的角度看，这里的习惯也许很难接受。
mondai1.trans_en: From an outsider's point of view these customs may be hard to accept.
mondai1.point_en: からみると = seen from.

mondai1.trans: 这本小说主人公的原型肯定是那个人。
mondai1.trans_en: The model for this novel's hero is undoubtedly that person.
mondai1.point_en: に相違ない = there is no mistake that.

mondai1.trans: 必须思考日本在亚洲的角色。
mondai1.trans_en: We have to think about Japan's role in Asia.
mondai1.point: 「における」是「において」的连体形。
mondai1.point_en: における = in (prenominal).

mondai1.trans: 本校可以学习以英语为首的七种语言。
mondai1.trans_en: Our school offers seven languages, starting with English.
mondai1.point_en: をはじめ = starting with / including foremost.

mondai1.trans: 听说昨晚的地震是震度3。
mondai1.trans_en: They say last night's quake was intensity 3.
mondai1.point_en: とか = I hear (soft hearsay).

mondai1.trans: 教也就是被教。
mondai1.trans_en: Teaching is nothing other than being taught.
mondai1.point_en: にほかならない = nothing other than.

mondai2.trans: 我输了是事实，只好承认。
mondai2.trans_en: It's a fact that I lost, so I have no choice but to admit it.
mondai2.point_en: よりほかない = nothing else to do but.

mondai2.trans: 他连写都不练，光盯着汉字看，那样肯定记不住。
mondai2.trans_en: He doesn't even practice writing, just stares at the kanji — that way he certainly won't remember them.
mondai2.point_en: に決まっている = it's certain that.

mondai2.trans: 节约虽好，但不能因为可惜就不开灯学习，那样眼睛会坏。
mondai2.trans_en: Saving is good, but you shouldn't study with the light off just because it's a waste.
mondai2.point: 「からといって」＝虽说如此也不能。
mondai2.point_en: からといって = just because … it doesn't mean.

mondai2.trans: 参加自由。不必为参加不参加而烦恼。
mondai2.trans_en: Attendance is optional. There's no need to agonize over whether to go.
mondai2.point_en: V(よ)うかVまいか = whether to or not.

mondai2.trans: 自从听到同学在教室说自己坏话，他就没再来学校。
mondai2.trans_en: Ever since he overheard classmates badmouthing him, he has stopped coming to school.
mondai2.point_en: て以来 = ever since.

mondai3.trans: 从四月上旬到中旬举办郁金香节。
mondai3.trans_en: A tulip festival is held from early to mid-April.
mondai3.point_en: にかけて = from A through B.

mondai3.trans: 虽说有节日，并不等于很多人在种郁金香。
mondai3.trans_en: Just because there's a festival doesn't mean many people grow tulips.
mondai3.point_en: からといって = that doesn't mean.

mondai3.trans: 不先把花种上，节日就办不成。
mondai3.trans_en: You can't hold the festival until the flowers have been planted.
mondai3.point_en: てからでないと = not until after.

mondai3.trans: 以日本产量第一的富山为首，各地的花都汇集过来。
mondai3.trans_en: Flowers gather from tulip-growing areas nationwide, starting with Toyama, Japan's top producer.
mondai3.point_en: をはじめ = starting with.

mondai3.trans: 听说数量之多全国数一数二。
mondai3.trans_en: I hear it's one of the top one or two in the country for volume.
mondai3.point_en: とか = I hear.

mondai1.trans: 无论是买还是借，课本都必须带来。
mondai1.trans_en: Whether you buy it or borrow it, you must bring the textbook.
mondai1.point_en: にしろ〜にしろ = whether A or B.

mondai1.trans: 以住院为契机买了保险。
mondai1.trans_en: Hospitalization was the trigger for taking out insurance.
mondai1.point_en: を契機として = taking that as a turning point.

mondai1.trans: 收到带着心意的礼物会很高兴。
mondai1.trans_en: It's nice to receive a gift that has feeling put into it.
mondai1.point_en: こめる = put (feeling) into.

mondai1.trans: 她既听不见也看不见。
mondai1.trans_en: She could neither hear nor see.
mondai1.point_en: も〜ば〜も = neither … nor / both.

mondai1.trans: 他顾不上衣服弄脏，抱起了受伤的人。
mondai1.trans_en: He scooped up the injured person without caring that his clothes would get dirty.
mondai1.point_en: もかまわず = without minding.

mondai1.trans: 那位钢琴家在国内外都很活跃。
mondai1.trans_en: That pianist is active both at home and abroad.
mondai1.point_en: を問わず = regardless of.

mondai1.trans: 通过志愿者活动为社会做贡献。
mondai1.trans_en: Contribute to society through volunteer work.
mondai1.point_en: を通じて = through.

mondai1.trans: 今天又是打雷又是地震，总觉得不平常。
mondai1.trans_en: What with thunder and then an earthquake, today feels anything but normal.
mondai1.point_en: やら〜やら lists mixed items.

mondai1.trans: 人就是会想要自己没有的东西。
mondai1.trans_en: People naturally want what they don't have.
mondai1.point_en: ものだ states a general truth.

mondai1.trans: 每当穿上这件衣服，就会想起母亲。
mondai1.trans_en: Whenever I wear this dress I think of my mother.
mondai1.point_en: につけ = every time / whenever.

mondai1.trans: 那种病有从动物传到人的危险。
mondai1.trans_en: That disease may spread from animals to humans.
mondai1.point_en: 恐れがある = there is a risk that.

mondai1.trans: 虽说对身体好，也不是吃得越多越好。
mondai1.trans_en: Just because it's healthy doesn't mean the more you eat the better.
mondai1.point_en: というものでもない = not necessarily.

mondai1.trans: 这座小镇有让人心情平静下来的东西。
mondai1.trans_en: This town has something that soothes the heart.
mondai1.point: 「ものがある」表示确实能感觉到某种特质。
mondai1.point_en: ものがある = there is something (notable).

mondai1.trans: 这本习题集是以实际课堂教材为基础编写的。
mondai1.trans_en: This workbook is based on materials actually used in class.
mondai1.point_en: をもとに = based on.

mondai1.trans: 网上预约时需要密码。
mondai1.trans_en: A password is required when you reserve online.
mondai1.point_en: 際 = when / at the time of.

mondai2.trans: 他们不可能理解。那纯粹是浪费时间。
mondai2.trans_en: There's no way they'll understand. It would just be a waste of time.
mondai2.point: 「というものだ」表示说话人的评价。
mondai2.point_en: というものだ = that's what I'd call.

mondai2.trans: 别人讨厌的事自己不该做。
mondai2.trans_en: You shouldn't do to others what they hate.
mondai2.point_en: ものではない = that's not what one should do.

mondai2.trans: 邮购目录常送来。不管希望不希望都会寄来。
mondai2.trans_en: Mail-order catalogs often arrive, whether you asked for them or not.
mondai2.point_en: にかかわらず = regardless of.

mondai2.trans: 书借给他以后被弄脏还回来了。再也不借了。
mondai2.trans_en: I lent him a book and it came back dirty. Never again.
mondai2.point_en: ものか = as if I would.

mondai2.trans: 以香烟涨价为契机想戒烟，但失败了。
mondai2.trans_en: I tried to quit smoking when the price went up, but failed.
mondai2.point_en: をきっかけに = taking that as a chance.

mondai3.trans: 以父母的友人为中心开始了募捐。
mondai3.trans_en: A fund-raising drive began, centered on the parents' friends.
mondai3.point_en: を中心に = centered on.

mondai3.trans: 在海外也有不问年龄就能做手术的国家。
mondai3.trans_en: Overseas there are countries where you can have the operation regardless of age.
mondai3.point_en: を問わず = regardless of.

mondai3.trans: 国家就不能想想办法吗？
mondai3.trans_en: Can't the government do something about this situation?
mondai3.point: 「ものでしょうか」表示不满的反问。
mondai3.point_en: ものか／ものでしょうか = (rhetorical) surely not / can't they.

mondai3.trans: 通过媒体报道，捐款从全国汇来。
mondai3.trans_en: Donations came in from all over the country through media coverage.
mondai3.point_en: を通じて = through.

mondai3.trans: 收到了许多充满心意的信件。
mondai3.trans_en: Many heartfelt letters arrived.
mondai3.point_en: こもった = filled with (feeling).

mondai1.trans: 未成年也能入会。不过需要监护人许可。
mondai1.trans_en: Minors can join. However, a guardian's permission is required.
mondai1.point_en: ただし = provided that / however.

mondai1.trans: “第一次看歌舞伎。”“那感觉怎么样？”
mondai1.trans_en: “I saw kabuki for the first time.” “So how was it?”
mondai1.point_en: それで = and so? (prompting).

mondai1.trans: 请带驾照或健康保险证等身份证明。
mondai1.trans_en: Please bring a driver's license or health-insurance card to prove your identity.
mondai1.point_en: あるいは = or.

mondai1.trans: 开瓶盖总是很费劲。于是就开发了这个商品。
mondai1.trans_en: I always struggled with jar lids. So I developed this product.
mondai1.point_en: そこで = and so (I did X).

mondai1.trans: “这张小猫照片真可爱。”“是啊。对了，最近没看见邻居家的猫呢。”
mondai1.trans_en: “This kitten photo is cute.” “Yeah. Come to think of it, I haven't seen the neighbor's cat lately.”
mondai1.point_en: そういえば = that reminds me.

mondai1.trans: 人气职业高尔夫选手后面跟着一大群也就是观众的人。
mondai1.trans_en: A popular pro golfer has a crowd of spectators — that is, a gallery — trailing after him.
mondai1.point_en: すなわち = namely / that is.

mondai1.trans: “信帮我寄了吗？”“那个啊，我忘了，还在包里。”
mondai1.trans_en: “Did you mail the letter?” “Well, I forgot — it's still in my bag.”
mondai1.point_en: それが = well, as it turns out.

mondai1.trans: “为什么不要收据？”“因为用不着嘛。”
mondai1.trans_en: “Why don't you take the receipt?” “Because I don't need it.”
mondai1.point_en: だって = because (defensive).

mondai1.trans: 啊，左手无名指有戒指…也就是说已经结婚了吧。
mondai1.trans_en: Ah, a ring on the left ring finger… so that means they're married?
mondai1.point: 「ということは」从事实推出结论。
mondai1.point_en: ということは = which means that.

mondai1.trans: 我能来这儿今天是最后一次。因为我要换工作了。
mondai1.trans_en: Today is the last time I can come here. That's because I'm changing jobs.
mondai1.point_en: というのは = the reason is.

mondai1.trans: “想了解日本传统文化。”“那就选这个课程吧。”
mondai1.trans_en: “I want to learn about traditional Japanese culture.” “In that case this course is good.”
mondai1.point: 「それなら」承接对方的话给建议。
mondai1.point_en: それなら = in that case.

mondai1.trans: “昨天真不容易。”“是啊，好累。对了，高桥选手拿奖牌了呢！”
mondai1.trans_en: “Yesterday was rough.” “Yeah, I was exhausted. Anyway — Takahashi won a medal!”
mondai1.point_en: それはそうと = anyway (new topic).

mondai1.trans: 感谢您的订购。另外，这封邮件是系统自动回复的。
mondai1.trans_en: Thank you for your order. Also, this email is an automatic reply.
mondai1.point_en: なお = additionally (formal).

mondai1.trans: 从书架取下一本书打开。于是里面夹着一张旧照片。
mondai1.trans_en: I took a book from the shelf and opened it. Then I found an old photo inside.
mondai1.point_en: すると = and then (what happened next).

mondai1.trans: 学分不够。因此你就不能毕业。
mondai1.trans_en: You don't have enough credits. Therefore you cannot graduate.
mondai1.point_en: したがって = therefore (formal).

mondai2.trans: 全球变暖被大肆炒作。可据某位知识人说，也有人认为没那回事。
mondai2.trans_en: Global warming is much talked about. But according to one intellectual, some say it isn't so.
mondai2.point_en: によれば = according to.

mondai2.trans: 请参加自治会清扫。不过这不是义务，而是自愿。
mondai2.trans_en: Please join the neighborhood cleanup. This is not an obligation, however, but voluntary.
mondai2.point_en: もっとも = although / that said.

mondai2.trans: 多次提醒这会考到别弄错。尽管如此还是有很多学生错了，真遗憾。
mondai2.trans_en: I warned them again and again this would be on the test. Even so, many students got it wrong.
option_translations_en: it was a pity many did
mondai2.point_en: それなのに = and yet.

mondai2.trans: 可以使用信用卡，或者便利店后付也可以。
mondai2.trans_en: You can use a credit card, or pay later at a convenience store.
mondai2.point_en: あるいは = or.

mondai2.trans: 这个项目的主题是“生态”，也就是考虑环境。
mondai2.trans_en: The theme of this project is “eco,” that is, thinking about the environment.
mondai2.point_en: すなわち = namely.

mondai3.trans: 且说，绿山市将为从未用过电脑的人开办电脑班。
mondai3.trans_en: Now then, Midoriyama City will offer a computer class for people who have never used a PC.
mondai3.point: 通知开头用「さて」转入正题。
mondai3.point_en: さて = now then (opening a topic).

mondai3.trans: 去年的参加者说“很实用，而且免费真好”。
mondai3.trans_en: Last year's participants said it was practical and, what's more, free.
option_translations_en: I want to join next year
mondai3.point: 和「わかりやすく、しかも」并列好评。
mondai3.point_en: しかも adds another plus.

mondai3.trans: “说起来，我还没用过电脑呢。”
mondai3.trans_en: “Come to think of it, I've never used a computer.”
mondai3.point: 「そういえば」想起自己的情况。
mondai3.point_en: そういえば = that reminds me.

mondai3.trans: 可以来教室，或者使用网上教材。
mondai3.trans_en: You can come to the classroom, or use the online materials.
mondai3.point_en: あるいは = or.

mondai3.trans: 另外，教材费另计。
mondai3.trans_en: Also, the cost of materials is extra.
mondai3.point_en: なお = additionally.
